subject.title: The two routes around one cell have the same value
The two routes around one cell have the same value

object.title: Map homotopic routes into a cover member

proof_context.conclusion: Paths with the same endpoints in a simply connected space give equal local values after mapping into $U_i$.
proof_context.explanation: Regard the map as taking values in $U_i$. Simple connectedness makes the two source paths homotopic; mapping that homotopy into $U_i$ identifies their classes, so $F_i$ gives equal values.

notation.math: The map from the simply connected space

snippet.text:
let g' : C(Y, U i) := ⟨fun y ↦ ⟨g y, hg y⟩, g.continuous.codRestrict hg⟩
  have hα : (α.map g.continuous).codRestrict (x := ⟨g y₀, hg y₀⟩) (y := ⟨g y₁, hg y₁⟩) hP =
      α.map g'.continuous := by
    ext t
    exact Path.codRestrict_coe (x := ⟨g y₀, hg y₀⟩) (y := ⟨g y₁, hg y₁⟩) _ hP t
  have hβ : (β.map g.continuous).codRestrict (x := ⟨g y₀, hg y₀⟩) (y := ⟨g y₁, hg y₁⟩) hQ =
      β.map g'.continuous := by
    ext t
    exact Path.codRestrict_coe (x := ⟨g y₀, hg y₀⟩) (y := ⟨g y₁, hg y₁⟩) _ hQ t
  simp only [locVal, hα, hβ,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.2 ((SimplyConnectedSpace.paths_homotopic α β).map g')]

object.title: The two routes around one cell have the same value

proof_context.conclusion: The two boundary routes across a cell have equal values.
proof_context.explanation: Parametrize the cell by the unit square and map its two routes through $H$. Line 652 invokes `locVal_eq_of_simplyConnected`; simple connectedness of the square supplies the homotopy between the routes.

snippet.text:
-- Both composites are images of paths from `(0, 0)` to `(1, 1)` in the square `I × I` under the
  -- affine parametrisation of the cell by the square.
  let g : C(I × I, X) := H.toContinuousMap.comp
    ((ContinuousMap.mk _ (Icc.continuous_convexComb (pt N l) (pt N (l + 1)))).prodMap
      (ContinuousMap.mk _ (Icc.continuous_convexComb (pt N k) (pt N (k + 1)))))
  refine locVal_eq_of_simplyConnected hU F hF i g
    (fun z ↦ hi _ (convexComb_mem_Icc_pt N l z.1) _ (convexComb_mem_Icc_pt N k z.2))
    (((Path.refl 0).trans Path.id).prod (Path.id.trans (Path.refl 1)))
    ((Path.id.trans (Path.refl 1)).prod ((Path.refl 0).trans Path.id)) _ _ (fun t ↦ ?_)
    (fun t ↦ ?_) _ _ <;>
  · rw [Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with h <;> rw [one_div] at h <;> simp [g, colSeg, Path.subpath, Path.trans_apply, h]

proof.summary: The cell argument applies a general helper to the unit square. The two excerpts show why mapped routes have equal values and where that result is used for the cell.
